cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20.0)

# --- FIX: Prevent ExecuTorch from exporting targets and crashing Zephyr ---
set(EXECUTORCH_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE INTERNAL "")
set(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES TRUE)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

find_package(Zephyr REQUIRED HINTS $ENV{ZEPHYR_BASE})
project(kws_qemu_test)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

target_sources(app PRIVATE src/main.cpp src/model.c)

# Link the core ExecuTorch library generated by the module
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE executorch portable_ops_lib)
